decisions.reason: The coolant cleaning centrifuge is tightly aligned with the firm's core process-media, sustainability and system-solution strategy, so accumulated development effort and visible commitment make withdrawal unlikely absent clear persistent failure.

The coolant nozzle line extends the established portfolio across several models and is likely embedded in broader machine and service sales, which strengthens sunk-cost and portfolio-justification pressures to retain it.

Although the scraper belt chip conveyor is somewhat more adjacent than core coolant products, it still supports the firm's announced direction in material flow and automation, so management would likely continue backing it for another year.

The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on the firm's established chip-handling business and broad systems offer, making continued market presence the more likely choice under escalation of commitment.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is close enough to the firm's existing transport and chip-conveying activities that prior investment, product-range breadth and the tendency to attribute weak uptake to temporary market factors argue for keeping it.
